stories.title: Israeli man killed in West Bank shooting hours before Yom Kippur as IDF thwarts a second attack
stories.reason: Netanel Shukrun was shot dead while immersing in a spring near Neveh Tzuf ahead of the holiday, and IDF commandos captured the gunman at a Ramallah-area hospital hours later, while a separate car-ramming attempt at a Jenin-area checkpoint was foiled, prompting reinforced security across the West Bank.

stories.title: Trump says the Houthis have agreed not to fight the US, even as they keep striking Saudi Arabia
stories.reason: Trump told Fox News Washington is in 'constant communication' with the group and rejected a Saudi request to strike Yemen directly, a de-escalation signal that comes just a day after a Houthi missile hit Riyadh and forced Trump to cut short his Camp David trip.

stories.title: Oil prices jump above $104 a barrel as Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia raise supply-risk fears
stories.reason: Brent crude climbed toward $105 after the weekend missile attack on Riyadh, adding a fresh geopolitical risk premium to energy markets already strained by the broader Iran war and threatening to push up fuel and shipping costs worldwide.

stories.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles within three hours, prompting emergency talks in Seoul
stories.reason: South Korea's presidential office convened its National Security Office and coordinated with Washington and Tokyo after the launches from Wonsan, the latest in a string of tests that came just over a week after North Korea's previous ballistic missile firing into the same waters.

stories.title: Germany's Merz calls state-election losses a 'disaster' but vows to stay on as AfD scores historic gains
stories.reason: The AfD won Mecklenburg-Vorpommern outright and the CDU posted its worst-ever result in any German state, with the Left Party overtaking Merz's party in Berlin -- a result the chancellor called a 'disaster' even as he rejected calls to step aside less than a year into office.

stories.title: Bessent hails 'very successful' US-China talks on AI and trade ahead of the Trump-Xi summit
stories.reason: After an eight-hour session in Manhattan, the US and China agreed to set up a dialogue and notification mechanism on AI security risks, alongside progress on the Busan trade truce and rare-earth exports, setting the stage for Trump's meeting with Xi in Washington this week.

stories.title: Google's Android-based Googlebook laptops open for preorder, priced to challenge Copilot Plus PCs and MacBook Air
stories.reason: Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo are shipping the first Googlebook devices this fall, running a new OS that blends ChromeOS and Android with built-in Gemini features, marking Google's biggest bet yet on AI-native laptops.

stories.title: Antitrust lawsuit accuses Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google of illegally coordinating an AI slowdown
stories.reason: The proposed class action, filed on behalf of paid ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini subscribers, alleges the companies' CEOs publicly coordinated a deliberate pullback in AI development after Anthropic's Dario Amodei called for industrywide deceleration, reducing the value subscribers pay for.
